name: Recreation
overview: Scripture reveals that recreation is a God-ordained necessity for rest and renewal, as seen in the command to observe the Sabbath by ceasing from work (Exodus 20:10). It is a gracious gift from God to enjoy the fruits of our labor with gladness (Ecclesiastes 3:13). Jesus Himself modeled the importance of taking time away from ministry demands to rest and refresh, inviting His disciples to withdraw privately for rest amid their busy service (Mark 6:31-32, Mark 7:24). Prioritizing God's kingdom remains essential, but He also provides space for physical and spiritual renewal in our lives (Matthew 6:33).
